title: Harness sheet results
description: Output of `dast harness`, written as data/harness/<sheet>/results.json. Carries every execution of the sheet, the flattened metrics row per completed run, and the cross-repeat variance — a named §T3 analyzer input. A dry run writes this too (dry_run:true, executions planned, metrics_rows empty). → docs/DATA.md.

sheet.description: The sheet id (the harness directory name).

base_env.description: The base env file the rows overlay.

dry_run.description: True when the plan was written but nothing executed — metrics_rows is then empty.

executions.description: One entry per row×repeat the sheet planned/ran.

label.description: The out-suffix this row's artifacts carry.

stages.description: The stage chain this row ran (list or mapping).

run.description: The run id it produced, or null if it did not run/complete.

failed_stage.description: The stage that failed, or null.

env_file.description: The per-row overlay written for this execution.

metrics_rows.description: The flattened index row per completed metrics record (metrics.index_row): identity, totals, and the outcome counters. Empty on a dry run.

variance.description: Per-counter min/max/mean/spread over repeated rows of one configuration — the 'a difference smaller than the spread is not a difference' yardstick. Empty when no counter had ≥2 repeats.
